criteria.criterion: A new test using a fake driver that returns the 401 text (`Failed to authenticate. API Error: 401 ... OAuth access token has expired`) for every call, after the producer has edited files, ends the job Failed with a reason starting `environment: producer login expired`. The test asserts that the closing holds a candidate commit with the producer's edits. Run `cargo test -p athena-core` and check that this test passes.
criteria.evidence: In release mode, `a_producer_login_expiry_keeps_its_edits_and_closes_as_an_environment_stop` passed, along with the no-edit/429 test, the timeout_seed test and the disk.rs `keeps_unfinished_work` test (4 passed). The test checks: state Failed; reason starts with `environment: producer login expired` and ends with `; its edits are kept as candidate <short>`; README.md in the candidate commit is the producer's text; a progress note exists; no resume mark; one producer call and no verifier. The same command in debug mode failed to compile. Verbose output shows athena-agent marked Fresh but stale in the shared target directory (build cache, not candidate code). The CI test record for this commit passed.

criteria.criterion: A new test shows `athena retry <job>` on that stopped job resumes from the kept candidate (the retry's seed or resume names the earlier job, and the earlier edits are present) instead of starting from scratch. Run `cargo test` and check that this test passes.
criteria.evidence: `retrying_a_login_expiry_stop_resumes_from_the_kept_work` passed (24 of 24 in tests/retry.rs). It checks: the first job is Failed with the environment reason; the retry's producer finds src/partial.rs already in its working directory; its brief has `## Resume`, the first job's id, `kept as candidate <short>` and `API Error: 401`, and does not say `reached its deadline`; the retry lands with the earlier file; check_history finds no violations. `timeout_seed_resumes_a_login_expiry_stop_but_not_other_failures` also passed.

criteria.criterion: A new test shows a driver that returns a 401 once and then succeeds yields a successful invocation: exactly two driver calls were made and the job does not end as an environment stop. Run `cargo test -p athena-agent` and check that this test passes.
criteria.evidence: `a_login_expiry_is_retried_once_and_a_second_call_succeeds` passed. It runs the real `ClaudeCodeDriver::invoke` against a stand-in child and checks: call count 2; outcome Success with structured answer 42; the second call has `--max-budget-usd 0.25`; the second prompt starts with RETRY_NOTE; cost is 0.252; usage, models and commands are summed. The driver returns Success, so the core never takes the environment-stop branch.

criteria.criterion: A test shows two consecutive 401 results lead to only one retry (two calls in total, no more) before the environment stop. Run `cargo test` and check that this test passes.
criteria.evidence: `two_login_expiries_make_two_calls_and_return_the_error` passed: exactly 2 calls, outcome Error, the detail starts with `success: Failed to authenticate. API Error: 401`, and the cost is 0.5. The core test (criterion 1) shows that this Error/401 output closes as an environment stop with the work kept.

criteria.criterion: The diff in crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs adds the single retry after a short wait on a 401. crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs (with run/producer.rs if needed) keeps partial work for a 401 stop by reusing `keep_timed_out_work`. crates/athena-core/src/disk.rs changes only if the classification or resume rules need it. All three are listed in `git diff`.

summary: The change does what was asked. When the model login expires, the producer's job now closes failed with the reason `environment: producer login expired`. Its edits are kept as a candidate commit with a progress note, through the same function the deadline path uses, now renamed `keep_unfinished_work`. `timeout_seed` uses the new `keeps_unfinished_work` check, so `athena retry` resumes from the kept candidate. The Claude driver retries a call once after a 30-second wait (tests shorten it), merges the two calls' cost and usage, and does not retry when time or budget runs short, on `athena stop`, or on a 429. I ran the new tests in release mode and they pass: the core login-expiry tests, the full CLI retry suite including the new resume test, the driver tests, the existing timeout tests and the drain login-expiry test. A debug build in the shared target directory first failed with "no `api_error_status` in `claude`". The verbose output showed an old athena-agent build that cargo treated as fresh, so the error came from the build cache, not the candidate. A clean release build compiled, and Athena's CI record for this commit shows fmt, clippy and the full test suite passing. The only findings are minor: briefs.rs changed although it is not on the expected deliverables list (it was planned and needed so the resume text stops saying "deadline"), and the retry note is added to every role's prompt, not only the producer's.
